exact: symbiont-mediated suppression of host neutrophil extracellular traps formation
related: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host neutrophil extracellular trap formation

definition: A process in which a symbiont inhibits or disrupts the formation of neutrophil extracellular traps by the host cell. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host neutrophil extracellular trap formation
